flags.label: Not yet assessed in this record
flags.detail: A teacher of al-Khatib in Nishapur, son of the Qur'an reciter Abu Bakr Muhammad ibn Muhammad al-Tarrazi (d. 385), of whom al-Khatib himself wrote in Tarikh Baghdad that he transmitted objectionable and false reports and used to narrate much from memory. We have not yet entered a critic's assessment of the son, and we do not invent one. The verdicts on this hadith do not turn on him.

bio: Al-Khatib heard this report from him in Nishapur with the formula “he informed us” (the manuscripts differ between two forms of it).
